context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

I want my services in Infrastructure Explorer filterable by Environment (prod/staging/dev), Service, and Team. Which tags or labels drive these ownership filters?

checklist.name: identifies-that-infrastructure-explorer-reads
checklist.description: Identifies that Infrastructure Explorer reads ownership from specific Kubernetes labels / cloud tags plus the documented deployment.environment.name exception, and names at least one supported key per filter — for example: Environment from any of `environment` / `cx_env` / `app.kubernetes.io/environment` / `CX_ENV_ID` / `deployment.environment.name`; Service from any of `service` / `cx_service` / `app.kubernetes.io/service` / `CX_SERVICE_NAME` (ideally noting fallback to the workload name when none are set); Team from `team` or `cx_team`. FAIL if the response asserts `service.name` is the Service ownership key (it isn't — `service.name` is the APM Service Catalog identifier; Infra Explorer ownership uses different keys), or if it makes up a reverse-DNS team attribute as the canonical answer.
